name: 2 Samuel
author: Not named in the text.
date: Covers David’s reign, about 1010 to 970 BC.
setting: David becomes king over Judah, then over all Israel, based in Jerusalem.
theme: God makes a covenant with David promising an everlasting kingdom, while David’s sin brings trouble to his house.

outline.label: David’s lament for Saul and Jonathan
Civil war between David and Saul’s house
Jerusalem and victory over the Philistines

christInBook: God’s promise that David’s throne will be established forever (7:12-16) is the center of the book. The New Testament announces Jesus as the Son of David whose kingdom has no end (Luke 1:32-33).
howToRead: Read chapter 7 as the hinge of the book. Before it, David rises. After it, David’s own sin shows that the promised king cannot be David himself.
